draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.37, the 1st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 1st of 17 at DE. He went 2nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Julius Peppers. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2019) ranked 1st in sacks among the 17 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 72 career games and 44 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 14 in 2020. Strengths in 2025: sacks 10.0 (91st percentile), tackles for loss 11 (89th percentile), pressures 30 (87th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 edge rusher who played: 10.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, above the norm.
